# App Deployer

> App Deployer is a self-hosted deployment orchestration platform. It lets teams create applications (tenants), each with environments (Prod, Staging, etc.) and deployment targets (API, Frontend, etc.), every target holding an ordered pipeline of shell steps. Deployments are triggered manually or via inbound webhooks (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket), run asynchronously, and stream live status and logs.

App Deployer is built for development teams who want to supervise their deployments without depending on a third-party SaaS for execution: SSH connections to target servers are encrypted and managed by the platform, environment variables are encrypted per environment, and roles (owner, manager, deployer, viewer) give precise control over who can trigger a deployment or change a pipeline.

## Key features

- Customizable deployment pipelines (ordered shell steps, per-step timeout, failure handling)
- Encrypted SSH connections to the customer's target servers
- Encrypted environment variables and secrets, isolated per environment
- Inbound GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket webhooks with branch → environment mapping
- Real-time deployment tracking (status, logs, cancellation) over WebSockets
- Team roles: owner, manager, deployer, viewer
- Full deployment history and audit log

## Note

The rest of the application (dashboard, application/environment/pipeline management,
members, billing) requires an account and is not meant to be indexed or summarized by
a crawler — those pages are explicitly marked `noindex`.
